steps.note: Open the Events list as required by the scenario.
Verify the Events list rendered successfully.
Verify the Create Event menu offers the Single Stage path.
Switch the initially selected event type to RFQ.
Set the required event title using the product's automatic unique title.
Choose the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is generated.
Add the CYLINDER product with the requested quantity.
Verify the RFQ product sheet rendered the expected columns.
Set the line item's delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001).

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, add Freight in Price Components, save it, and stop when the screen proves Freight appears as an extra vendor-entered price component and is included in the displayed totals.

steps.note: Perform and verify the Price Components interaction, which has no dedicated catalog step.
